specification.input_notes: The three GEO series (GSE14407, GSE29450, GSE54388) are the raw microarray data. The paper states all three used the Affymetrix Human Genome U133 Plus 2.0 Array platform. No processed expression matrices are listed; the RAW.tar files contain the raw CEL files. The deposit listing does not include sample annotation files, which are needed to assign cancer vs normal groups.

specification.specification_gaps: The paper does not specify: (1) how samples were assigned to cancer vs normal groups from the GEO series; (2) whether all samples in each series were used; (3) the exact version of the limma package; (4) how median normalization was implemented; (5) the direction of overlap (upregulated vs downregulated) for the 708 genes; (6) whether the Venn diagram tool used any additional filtering.
